spoof.note: real synthetic speech; SINGLE generator + single source speaker — unseen-generator performance NOT yet measured

evaluation_metrics.note: PILOT metrics on a small real-data eval set (44 clips). Acceptance gate <0.15 EER met. Single-generator training means these numbers do NOT generalize to unseen TTS/VC systems.

calibration.method: logit-margin sigmoid, theta/temperature fit on validation split (see ai_engine/vanirakshak-aasist/reports/calibration.json)

known_limitations: single generator (freevc24) in training — unseen-generator EER unmeasured
fake-side speaker-disjoint split impossible (all fakes share one source speaker)
44-clip test set — wide confidence intervals; pilot-scale
Marathi not yet included (fleurs mr_in + IndicSynth Marathi shards pending)
